title: 第17章 首次炼器
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
周伯的院子里有股焦糊味。

    陈青山刚进门，就看见老头儿蹲在炉边，用铁钩拨弄一块烧黑的铜片。

    “回来了？”

    周伯头也没抬。

    “嗯。”

    陈青山把怀里的布包打开，乌金初胚露了出来。

    周伯接过去，拿在手里翻了两下，又用指甲在边角刮了刮。

    “融合的还行，八成往上。”

    他把初胚放回布上。

    “不过也就是个初胚，没打磨，没刻纹，没淬火，拿出去卖不上价。”

    陈青山早猜到会是这样，还是问了一句：“若要炼成下品法器，大概要多久？”

    “熟手三天，生手七天。”

    周伯瞥了他一眼。

    “你五天。”

    五天。

    陈青山指腹在布包上蹭了蹭，布面有些粗，磨得指尖发痒。

    “坊市有人出四十块灵石，让我代炼一件下品法器。”

    周伯这才抬头。

    “你接了？”

    “接了。”

    “胆子不小。”

    周伯扔下铁钩，站起身，拍了拍手上的黑灰。

    “炼废了，材料你赔。赔不起，坊市会替人把账要回来。你这条小命，未必值那点材料钱。”

    陈青山没吭声。

    他当然知道。

    可那块“玄”字金属片就在眼前，不拿下来，晚上睡觉都不踏实。

    周伯看了他半晌，转身进屋，没一会儿扔出一本旧册子。

    册子边角卷起，封面油腻腻的，上面写着《炼器基础三十六式》。

    “拿去看。”

    周伯又从架子上抽出两块废铜，扔到炉边。

    “从今天起，每天下午过来一个时辰，我教你刻两道最简单的灵纹。别指望一下子学会，炼器不是熬粥，火大火小都能入口。”

    陈青山接住册子，拱手道：“多谢师父。”

    “少来这套。”

    周伯背着手，往炉边走。

    “我没收徒，你也别乱喊。真炼废了，别说是我教的。”

    陈青山低头应了一声，嘴角却压不住。

    老头儿嘴硬。

    但册子是真的。

    接下来三天，陈青山白天照旧在器峰做事，下午去周伯那里挨骂，晚上回屋翻那本旧册子。

    三天下来，他刻废了六块废铜，手指也被刻刀划了两道口子。

    第一遍看过去，满纸都是火候、锤法、灵力走向，脑袋发胀。

    第二遍稍好些，至少能看懂“文火慢熔”“三锤定脊”这些名目。

    第三遍翻到“疾纹”时，识海里的造化鼎忽然轻轻一震。

    纸上的线条像活了过来。

    火焰该压到什么颜色，刀胚软到几分能落锤，灵力入纹时该快还是慢，这些东西没有变成文字，却一股脑儿塞进他的脑子里。

    陈青山盯着那页纸，半天没眨眼。

    好家伙。

    这鼎以前的主人，怕不是个真正的炼器老怪。

    第三天傍晚，外门杂役送来一枚无字木牌。

    木牌背面刻着一个“槐”字，是坊市任务登记处给他的联系牌。

    陈青山捏着木牌去了槐树镇，茶摊老人看了一眼，指了指后巷。

    后巷尽头，一个戴青色面具的人等在那里，黑袍罩身，看不出年纪男女。

    “陈道友？”

    “是我。”

    青色面具递来一个布包。

    “赤铜石三斤，寒铁精半斤，火云石一块。我要一柄七寸飞刀，刻‘疾’、‘锋’两道灵纹，七天后坊市交货。”

    陈青山打开布包看了一眼。

    赤铜石成色偏暗，寒铁精倒是干净，火云石有指节大小，够用。

    “报酬四十块灵石。”

    青色面具又补了一句。

    “炼废了，按原价赔。一共六十五块灵石。”
content_en:
There is a burning smell in Uncle Zhou's yard.

    As soon as Chen Qingshan entered the door, he saw the old man squatting by the stove, using an iron hook to fiddle with a piece of blackened copper.

    "Back?"

    Uncle Zhou didn't even raise his head.

    "Yeah."

    Chen Qingshan opened the cloth bag in his arms, revealing the first embryo of Wujin.

    Uncle Zhou took it, turned it over twice in his hand, and scratched the corners with his nails.

    "The integration is not bad, 80% is better."

    He placed the embryo back on the cloth.

    "But it's just an embryo. It hasn't been polished, carved, or quenched. It won't be sold at a high price."

    Chen Qingshan had already guessed that this would be the case, so he still asked: "How long will it take to refine a low-grade magic weapon?"

    "Three days for an experienced person, seven days for a newbie."

    Uncle Zhou glanced at him.

    "Five days for you."

    five days.

    Chen Qingshan rubbed his fingertips on the cloth bag. The cloth was a little rough and made his fingertips itch.

    "Someone in the city gave me forty spiritual stones and asked me to refine a low-grade magic weapon on my behalf."

    Only then did Uncle Zhou raise his head.

    "Did you answer it?"

    "Took it."

    "Not timid."

    Uncle Zhou dropped the iron hook, stood up, and patted the black ash on his hands.

    "If the refining is ruined, you have to pay for the materials. If you can't afford the compensation, Fangshi will get the account back. Your little life may not be worth the money for the materials."

    Chen Qingshan said nothing.

    Of course he knows.

    But the piece of metal with the word "Xuan" is right in front of me. If I don't take it off, I won't be able to sleep well at night.

    Uncle Zhou looked at him for a long time, then turned and entered the room, and soon threw out an old booklet.

    The corners of the book were rolled up, and the cover was greasy, with "Thirty-six Basic Forms of Weapon Refining" written on it.

    "Take it and see."

    Uncle Zhou took out two more pieces of scrap copper from the shelf and threw them to the stove.

    "From today on, come here for an hour every afternoon, and I will teach you how to carve two of the simplest spiritual patterns. Don't expect to learn it all at once. Refining a weapon is not like making porridge. You can eat it even if it is hot or small."

    Chen Qingshan caught the booklet, cupped his hands and said, "Thank you, Master."

    "Stop doing this."

    Uncle Zhou walked towards the stove with his hands behind his back.

    "I don't have any disciples, so don't yell. If you are really useless, don't say it was me who taught you."

    Chen Qingshan lowered his head and responded, but he couldn't hold back the corners of his mouth.

    The old man was tough-talking.

    But the booklet is real.

    In the next three days, Chen Qingshan continued to work at Qifeng during the day, went to Uncle Zhou's place in the afternoon to get scolded, and went back to the house to read the old book at night.

    In three days, he carved six pieces of scrap copper, and his fingers were cut twice with the carving knife.

    After reading it for the first time, the paper was full of fire, hammering techniques, and spiritual power, and my head felt swollen.

    The second time was a little better, at least I could understand the terms "melting slowly with slow fire" and "three hammers to determine the spine".

    When I turned to "Ji Wen" for the third time, the cauldron of creation in the sea of ​​consciousness suddenly shook slightly.

    The lines on the paper seemed to come alive.

    What color should the flame be pressed to, how soft should the blade be enough to drop a hammer, and how fast or slow should the spiritual power enter the pattern? These things were not turned into words, but they were all stuffed into his mind.

    Chen Qingshan stared at the page without blinking for a long time.

    Good guy.

    The previous owner of this cauldron was probably not a real expert in refining weapons.

    On the evening of the third day, the servant at the outer gate delivered a wooden sign without words.

    On the back of the wooden sign is engraved the word "槐", which is the contact sign given to him by the Fang City Mission Registration Office.

    Chen Qingshan held the wooden sign and went to Huaishu Town. The old man at the tea stall took a look and pointed to the back alley.

    At the end of the back alley, a man wearing a cyan mask was waiting there. He was covered in black robes and could not tell the age of the man or woman.

    "Fellow Daoist Chen?"

    "It's me."

    Cyan Mask handed over a cloth bag.

    "Three kilograms of red copper stone, half a kilogram of cold iron essence, and a piece of fire cloud stone. I want a seven-inch flying knife, engraved with the two spiritual patterns of 'Ji' and 'Feng', and it will be delivered to the market in seven days."

    Chen Qingshan opened the cloth bag and took a look.

    The red copper stone is dark in color, the cold iron essence is clean, and the fire cloud stone is about the size of a knuckle, which is enough.

    "The reward is forty spiritual stones."

    The cyan mask added another sentence.

    "If the refining is useless, the original price will be paid. A total of sixty-five spiritual stones."
